rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
2 x DIMM slots, max. 128GB, DDR5 Supports up to
8200+MT/s(OC) with Ryzen™ 9000 Series Processors,
9600+MT/s(OC) with Ryzen™ 8000 Series Processors,
8000+MT/s(OC) with Ryzen™ 7000 Series Processors, 
ECC and Non-ECC Un-buffered DIMM*
Dual channel memory architecture

ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP)

Adjustments will be made based on the specifications of mass-produced memory products available on the market.
* Non-ECC, un-buffered DDR5 memory supports On-Die ECC function.
